description: Browse what independent MCP indexes measured, including servers this catalog does not list yet (casou=0). Newest change first. `casou=0` is what the indexes know and the catalog does not — the list to look at before submitting a server. Filters are AND'd.

api_pass.description: MAT-only private pass: mat_<32 random hex>_<64 random hex>. Generate and save before buying.

casou.description: 1 matched to a listing, 0 not in the catalog.

estado.description: vivo, fora, parado, abandonado, apagado, desconhecido.

fonte.description: One index: wellknown, agent_tools, nerq, truespar, neuronto, paygent, hultra.

q.description: Substring of name, URL or repository.

retry_key.description: Optional retry key, up to 80 ASCII characters; same read for five minutes.

name: mcp_index_search
